scenario_interpretation: Adverse/base/favorable assumption sensitivities. No assigned probabilities and no prediction-interval coverage claim.
facts: S1 p16 confirms owner PAT71.90/51.67/66.44 in current June, current September and prior September. S2 p19 confirms prior-December owner PAT41.70.
Prior-December PBT before exceptional items is89.74cr. Its30.10cr labour charge is separate from recurring service, finance and operating costs.
issuer_claims: S3 pp14,18 clarifies forward India leisure/MICE December-quarter bookings are30% higher in value, and that India basket is roughly51% of the travel segment, not the entire group.
S3 pp18–19 says international recovery remains uneven. Sterling input-GST cost impact is discussed as4cr in Q2 and is not presented here as a temporary addback.
assumptions: Base pretax changes from the prior December anchor: India+8, financial services+3, Sterling+4, internationalDMS-8, DEI-2, other income+10, cost inflation/central costs-3 and scheme cost-1 = PBT100.74.
The +10 treasury adjustment retains only part of Q2 other-income uplift from prior December40.93 to current58.87. All forward component amounts are analyst assumptions, not company guidance.
Base effective tax29%, associates0.3 and NCI3.5. Current group perimeter, including Sterling, is retained. No demerger completion or new labour past-service charge assumed.
unknowns: Booking cancellations, visa/flight constraints and conversion of advance bookings into recognized net income.
International DMS and DEI recovery, forex/MTM gains and owner-NCI mix.
Legal-scheme completion and any change to December reported group scope.
units: INR crore except ratios, percentages and stated operating units
normalization_basis: Prior Q2 property sale: subtract17.74cr, the explicitly disclosed parent-company post-tax gain in S1 note7. Prior Q3 labour charge30.1cr: add21.07 assuming30%tax relief and full owner attribution. Labour amount is documented, its tax/NCI split is not. That21.07 is an analyst normalization estimate, not an issuer-reported adjusted owner PAT. Current legal-scheme charges0.20/0.84 remain because further costs may recur.
normalization_uncertainty: Labour addback at25%tax would be22.575 instead of21.07, and minority attribution could reduce either. Reported and normalized baselines are both retained.
baseline_correction: No current owner-PAT correction. Q1 owner71.90 exceeds group63.71 because NCI loss is8.19. The bridge must include equity associates0.21/0.08. Prior September property gain and prior December labour charge create opposite seasonality distortions.
rationale: Use prior December pre-exception PBT as the seasonal operating anchor, then separately vary India travel, international DMS, Sterling, financial services, DEI, treasury and ongoing scheme costs. This avoids projecting a30% booking-value claim onto the entire group. Tax and minority profit convert the business-level estimate to owners.
